acceptanceCriteria: The protocol-owned pilot definition is the only source for shared work-item outcome parameter defaults and enum values consumed by CLI, MCP, and the interface description.
A focused parity test detects drift between the actual CLI/MCP parser schemas and the generated description; changing one pilot fact requires no second hand-maintained fact table.
The JSON and Markdown capability descriptions are deterministic, and the checked-in EN/zh-CN/JA generated regions match the same projection.
Capability discovery remains read-only and starts no verification, scan, or Work Item-history subprocess.
Lifecycle, authorization, Outcome delivery, language facts, and existing command behavior remain unchanged.
goal: A change to the pilot interface facts updates the CLI parser expectations, MCP schema, machine description, and generated EN/zh-CN/JA reference region from one deterministic source without changing lifecycle or Outcome delivery behavior.
intent: Complete the BAML-inspired work-item outcome interface discovery pilot by removing repeated interface facts from transport adapters and keeping CLI, MCP, and generated reference output derived from one protocol-owned definition.
outOfScope: Outcome rendering or host delivery semantics
sources: User objective: BAML interface discovery pilot and single source of truth
